svg.title: LumaQuote process and trust boundaries
svg.desc: Staff uses native React and FastAPI. When Auth, PostgreSQL or Storage is unreachable the API answers a safe retryable 503. A native worker shares local private business storage and runs an offline parser. A separate signed gateway accepts GAS snapshots and signed WhatsApp webhooks from Meta or Twilio, and serves Twilio a signed, expiring quotation PDF link. The worker sends through the configured WhatsApp provider only when live sending is enabled, and long-polls a Telegram bot directly (no inbound endpoint), storing updates before confirming them. Apps Script also pushes signed Gmail mails from one label to the gateway and pulls queued email replies, which it sends from Gmail. OpenAI and masked LangSmith job tracing are optional.
